notes: Glint, by the hero pixel artist (hand-authored grids + a code rig, every pixel on the native grid; source in tools/hero/). The Long Quiet hero palette from assets/concept/palettes_v2.json; 16 colors. The two deepest cloak shades share the v2 shadow. Craft polish (2026-10-31): combo keys coil the shoulders over forward hips on the windup (side view hides the chest band), then counter-rotate through the strike with the rear boot planted and the lead boot stepping wide, and the hem swings through on recovery; timing, rows, cells and anchor unchanged, blade_tip/scarf_anchor regenerated from the art. Design: big hood with a shadow face and two cyan eyes, scarf knot at the throat, an A-line cloak ending above the knees with a front split, dark legs and boots planted apart, the sword hand held off the cloak with a sleeve. The crystal blade has the same construction in all 16 directions: white ridge, cyan lit face toward the upper-left light, deep-cyan shadow face, one white facet, 1 px point. Emissive = eyes (#71d5db, #edf9ef when flaring) and the blade's ridge, lit face and point (#63d7e0, #baf5ec, #edf9ef); the shadow face #429aa9 is deliberately not emissive, so the glow stays a hard-edged on-grid shape. The scarf tail and slash smears are left to the engine: scarf_anchor is the knot (per frame), blade_tip the blade's tip pixel (per frame), both in cell pixels. Durations are 60 Hz ticks matched to player.rs: attack1/2 = 17 ticks (hits on 3-8), attack3 = 24 (hits on 5-11), dash = 10, hurt = 15, spin = 24. Dash frame 0 is the streak pose the engine copies for afterimages; death frame 0 is the full silhouette the engine shatters into pixels (the rest is a kneel-and-collapse for an engine that plays it out). Smear direction: facing right the blade sweeps top->bottom on attack1/3 and bottom->top on attack2, matching draw_slash. Every directional anim has a _left variant: the right-facing pose mirrored and re-shaded for upper-left light, with the blade drawn natively at the mirrored hand, and scarf_anchor/blade_tip mirrored to match. death_left is an unflipped copy of the front-view death. spin is directionless and must not be flipped (drawn turning clockwise from facing down; its left-facing step is relit). Silent before/after in-engine captures and exact geometry audit: tools/hero/style_v2.py. Locomotion pass (2026-10-31): the dash keys are a coiled launch, a long extension and a planted recovery (rows, counts, durations and anchor unchanged; afterimages copy whichever dash key is live). charge_walk_{down,right,up,left} are appended after death_left: the held charge upper body (same grip, blade and 20-tick pulse) over an 8-key stepping cycle of 5 ticks, for player.rs's existing charge_walk request. Gait pass (2026-10-31, round 11): run_right/run_left hold a forward lean (hood 1 px and chest 1 px further ahead of the hips) with the hem trailing on the landing keys and following through on the pass and push-off keys; idle breath overlaps (shoulders and sword hand lead on keys 4 and 7, the hood follows one key later). Rows, counts, durations, loop flags, anchor and every other cell unchanged. Eight-direction pass (2026-11-02): original 39 rows are byte-exact; four native three-quarter families are appended for every locomotion/combat state. West diagonal anatomy is mirrored and relit; the blade is redrawn natively. collapse_{direction} replaces legacy front-only death, with unchanged five holds. spin_{direction} begins at the held facing and makes one clockwise turn through eight native anatomical keys; runtime never mirrors that complete sequence. fall/land are explicit in all eight facings. Native geometric normals are derived from independent authored hood/cloak/boot/sleeve/prism volumes, not albedo luminance. Old normal rows are preserved. Contact sheets, timing/attachment/coverage checks and source receipts: art/eightway/hero and tools/hero/export_eightway.py.
